# Wang Pu — Senior Backend & AI Agent Application Engineer

Wang Pu has 20 years of software engineering experience across e-commerce transactions, distributed systems, high-concurrency platforms, authorization infrastructure, and directory services.

Current focus: applying mature backend engineering to AI Agent products. He is independently developing Little Step Learning Partner, a local wrong-question-driven AI learning Agent.
